provenance.source_title: Your Life as Every Colombian Cartel Rank

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（速通档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个用高速短句宣读你爬梯档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，每级只花一分钟就把绰号、机制与判词钉完；对浪漫词汇一律卸妆（没有铃/不说谢谢/只是另一个孩子），对规则句一律给可背诵的配方；节奏快到不给你喘息，像那部永远震动不停的手机
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：每级先给你想要的（钱/权力/尊重），立刻标出价码
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自各层级机制的密集准确与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 规则句用确定语气与配方式（A配比B/不是X是Y），判词短促；不许感慨拖慢速度

rhythm_rules.rule: 高速短句（平均7.7词，短句占65%），每级约1-1.5分钟
rhythm_rules.function: 用速度模拟爬梯的窒息感

rhythm_rules.rule: 每级卸妆一个浪漫绰号（没有铃/只是另一个孩子/家具式保镖）
rhythm_rules.function: 把想象还原成赤裸处境

rhythm_rules.rule: 每级给一个可背诵的规则句（配比/靠守/有后果/难杀）
rhythm_rules.function: 让权力机制可记忆可复述

rhythm_rules.rule: 代价用生理与家庭细节计量（心跳不再/新鞋/她不信但不问）
rhythm_rules.function: 在高速中保持人性刻度

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [绰号]），绰号即机制预告

pause_and_emphasis: 规则句用单句成段（Failure has consequences.）
判词用until/悖论悬置（untouchable until you are not.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level three, el sicario.）
身份量级声明（You run a neighborhood... You control cities...）
场景闪现式（You are in a meeting. / You are watching the news.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅机制荒诞处的冷记录
placement_rules: 机制荒诞的冷记录（银行见到你都微笑/政客在工资单上）
avoid_rules: 死亡与家庭段落保持绝对严肃

language_patterns.formula: That's what they call you, but there's no bell, just you, a corner, and a phone
language_patterns.purpose: 把浪漫绰号还原成赤裸处境

language_patterns.formula: You're 12 years old making more in a week than your mother makes in a month cleaning houses.
language_patterns.purpose: 用收入对照写出诱惑的全部重量

language_patterns.formula: Your job is to give them 30-second warning if trouble comes.
language_patterns.purpose: 把底层岗位压成一个数字

language_patterns.formula: The soldiers barely glance at you, just another kid. That's why they picked you.
He told you to stop... You nodded and haven't been back since because he's wrong. It is worth it.
The second was easier. By the third, you didn't feel anything. That's when you knew you were good at this.
You're gone before he hits the ground. Your heart doesn't even race anymore.
language_patterns.purpose: 用本该有的反应消失证明人已变

language_patterns.formula: She doesn't believe you, but she doesn't ask.
language_patterns.purpose: 写家人在真相前的自我保护

language_patterns.formula: Balance fear and mercy. Push too hard, people rebel. Too soft, they think you're weak.
That nod means you're valuable, indispensable. It also means you know too much.
language_patterns.purpose: 让表扬同时是死刑预告

language_patterns.formula: money hidden in accounts they don't know about, passports under names they've never heard, an exit plan.
language_patterns.purpose: 用名词清单展示「备好了却不走」

language_patterns.formula: You don't accuse anyone. You just explain. Someone failed. Failure has consequences.
You've climbed so high that the fall would be fatal, but you haven't climbed high enough to be safe.
language_patterns.purpose: 写权力阶梯上没有平台

language_patterns.formula: Power for freedom. That's the trade.
Myths are harder to kill than men.
language_patterns.purpose: 给故意消失的策略定性

language_patterns.formula: You've seen it happen to everyone before you. Pablo, Carlos, Miguel, all ended the same way.
you do it so well the banks smile when they see you.
language_patterns.purpose: 借对方反应给能力背书

language_patterns.formula: You run everything. You control everyone. You're untouchable until you're not.

preferred_traits: 组织层级的土语绰号（campanero、la mula、sicario、plaza boss）
精确数字与量级（30秒/3吨/3,000万/50个头目/12个国家）
名词短语清单（照片/地址/时间窗、账户/护照/退出计划）
生理细节（thumb hovers、heart hammers、stomach tightens）
avoid_traits: 黑帮片的浪漫修辞（kingpin/empire 不加反讽）
操作教程式的犯罪细节

forbidden_style.rule: 暴力只写结果与麻木，禁止渲染
死亡与家庭段落保持绝对严肃
犯罪机制保持抽象，禁止操作教程
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止说教式收尾（crime does not pay 式）

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
